physiological_equivalent_description: Craniospinal compliance: the volume the craniospinal space accepts per mmHg of ICP rise. The bedside quantity behind PVI, RAP and 'compensatory reserve'. Falls as the cranium is loaded; a low value means a small further volume produces a large ICP rise. Computed as 1/(E*(ICP_baseline - Pcv)) from the fitted elastance coefficient E.
bound_source: craniospinal compliance 0.5-1.1 mL/mmHg in adults; <0.4 is reduced reserve
caveat: No healthy controls exist in this dataset - all four recordings are ICU patients. Healthy bounds are from literature, not from a control group measured with this pipeline.
